newsitem.title: USA: US spot prods fall on API data, big gasoline build.
newsitem.headline: US spot prods fall on API data, big gasoline build.

text.p: U.S. spot products prices fell sharply in after-hours ACCESS trade following new weekly API data showing a whopping 3.6-million-barrel build in gasoline stocks and a 2.6 million barrel increase in distillates last week.
May gasoline futures slipped 0.75 cent and May heating oil fell 0.60 cent by 1745 EDT (2145 GMT), about an hour and a half after release of the new API data.
Traders were animated in their surprise at the gasoline build for the week ending April 11, with reformulated grades accounting for only 162,000 barrels of the growth.

"There's a huge dislocation here. All the barrels seem to be in one place -- in New York Harbor," one East Coast player said, noting total inventories in his region grew by a whopping 3.4 million barrels.
"The East Coast looks like dirt now in light of these numbers," the trader said, predicting that Wednesday NYMEX values will retreat on the data.
